subject: humanities
passage: Whaling voyages in the 1800s could last three years or more, and sailors had long stretches of empty time between hunts. Many filled the hours with scrimshaw: they scratched pictures of ships, whales, and faraway ports into whale teeth with a sailmaker's needle, then rubbed soot or ink into the lines to make the images stand out. Though the sailors rarely had any art training, some of their carvings are remarkably ______, with details as fine as a pen drawing.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

explanation.why: "Though" sets up a contrast with "rarely had any art training," and the phrase after the comma describes "details as fine as a pen drawing." Untrained sailors producing such fine work is surprising skill, so "skillful" fits.
explanation.A: Incorrect. Whale teeth are small, and the text is about the fine detail of the carvings, not their size.
explanation.B: Incorrect. The text says nothing about what the carvings were worth; it describes how well they were made.
explanation.C: Correct. Despite having no training, the sailors produced carvings with fine detail, which shows skill.
explanation.D: Incorrect. Details "as fine as a pen drawing" are the opposite of plain.
